task.name: Strike_camp_lighting
task.when: During Strike before dismantling any structure that supports lighting

step.action: Have the Power Lead de-energize and verify each lighting circuit before removal.
Disconnect each de-energized lighting circuit in the printed order.
Remove each light from its support.
Inspect each retrieved light, cord, plug, and connector for damage.
step.ifThen: IF damage is present, THEN separate and mark the component out of service.

step.action: Coil each cable in the method shown in 📦 Build_Book.
Pack lights, controls, supports, and cables in their assigned system containers.

passWhen.criterion: Every removed lighting circuit is de-energized.
Every light, control, support, cord, plug, and connector is accounted for and packed by system.
Damaged components are separated and marked out of service.
The Power Lead released each supporting structure for strike.
